summary: Join our Sovereign Risk and Debt Sustainability Training Course to master key concepts and strategies. Boost your expertise and navigate financial challenges.
lede: Sovereign credit risk analysis helps public-debt and macro-fiscal professionals assess debt sustainability, liquidity and refinancing exposure. The training covers reconciling debt data, building baseline projections and financing-needs calculations, and testing growth, interest-rate and exchange-rate shocks. Participants also practice mapping debt portfolio risks and presenting findings through reports and dashboards for policy and investment decisions.
audienceIntro: This sovereign risk and debt sustainability training is designed for professionals who assess public liabilities, manage borrowing portfolios, review fiscal exposure, or translate sovereign debt evidence for policy and investment decisions.
modules: Sovereign Risk and IMF SRDSF Foundations
Debt Data Using GFSM and PSDS
IMF Stress Tests and Fan Charts
prerequisites: You need a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed for model-building exercises. Power BI Desktop is recommended for the dashboard workshop, although the trainer can provide a spreadsheet-based alternative where installation policies restrict access. No coding or advanced econometrics is required. Advanced topics such as fan charts, fiscal reaction functions, and AI-assisted anomaly detection are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels.
